title.en: FDG-PET report: metabolic pattern in parkinsonism
title.zh: FDG-PET 帕金森综合征代谢模式分析报告

subtitle.en: Automated comparison with healthy controls. Decision support for the reading physician, not a diagnosis.
subtitle.zh: 与健康对照的自动化比较分析。供阅片医师参考的辅助决策信息，不构成诊断。

meta-score-w.en: W-scores: distance from what the controls predict for the same {0}, in standard deviations
meta-score-w.zh: W 值：与对照对相同{0}者的预测值之间的偏离，以标准差为单位

meta-score-z.en: z-scores: distance from the control mean in standard deviations, not adjusted for age or sex
meta-score-z.zh: Z 值：与对照均值之间的偏离，以标准差为单位，未校正年龄和性别

method-ps.en: proportional scaling to the gray-matter mean (ps)

name-cbd.zh: 皮质基底节变性/综合征（CBD/CBS）

expect-msa-p.en: Decrease in the putamen (the posterior part first), pons and cerebellum.
expect-msa-p.zh: 壳核（后部为著）、脑桥和小脑代谢减低。

expect-msa-c.en: Decrease in the cerebellum and pons, often with the putamen.
expect-msa-c.zh: 小脑和脑桥代谢减低，常伴壳核减低。

expect-psp.en: Decrease in the midbrain, medial frontal cortex and anterior cingulate, with caudate, thalamus and lateral frontal cortex.
expect-psp.zh: 中脑、内侧额叶及前扣带回代谢减低，伴尾状核、丘脑和额叶外侧减低。

expect-cbd.en: Clearly asymmetric decrease in the peri-central and parietal cortex, with the thalamus and striatum of the same side.
expect-cbd.zh: 一侧中央周围区和顶叶皮层明显不对称的代谢减低，伴同侧丘脑和纹状体减低。

expect-dlb.en: Decrease in the occipital cortex, with parietal cortex and precuneus; posterior cingulate relatively preserved (cingulate island sign).
expect-dlb.zh: 枕叶皮层代谢减低，伴顶叶皮层和楔前叶减低；后扣带回相对保留（扣带回岛征）。

expect-pd.en: No decrease in striatum, brainstem or cerebellum; relative increase in putamen, pallidum, thalamus, pons, cerebellum and sensorimotor cortex.
expect-pd.zh: 纹状体、脑干和小脑无减低；壳核、苍白球、丘脑、脑桥、小脑和感觉运动皮层相对代谢增高。

concl-pattern.en: The metabolic pattern is most compatible with {0} (pattern match {1}/100, confidence: {2}).
concl-pattern.zh: 代谢模式最符合{0}（模式匹配度 {1}/100，置信度：{2}）。

concl-indeterminate.en: The map shows features of both {0} ({1}/100) and {2} ({3}/100). The two cannot be told apart reliably from this scan.
concl-indeterminate.zh: 图像同时具有{0}（{1}/100）和{2}（{3}/100）的特征，仅凭本次检查无法可靠区分。

concl-possible.en: The map shows only mild or partial features of {0} (pattern match {1}/100). This is not enough to assign a pattern.
concl-possible.zh: 图像仅表现出{0}的轻度或部分特征（模式匹配度 {1}/100），不足以判定为该模式。

concl-pd.en: No decrease typical of atypical parkinsonism was found. The relative increase in subcortical and sensorimotor regions matches the pattern described in {0} (pattern match {1}/100, confidence: {2}).
concl-pd.zh: 未见非典型帕金森综合征的典型代谢减低。皮层下及感觉运动区的相对代谢增高符合{0}的模式（模式匹配度 {1}/100，置信度：{2}）。

concl-none.en: No pattern of atypical parkinsonism was found. In a patient with parkinsonism this favours Parkinson's disease, whose FDG-PET is often close to normal early on, but it does not exclude other causes.
concl-none.zh: 未见非典型帕金森综合征的代谢模式。对于帕金森综合征患者，这一结果更倾向于帕金森病（其早期 FDG-PET 常接近正常），但不能排除其他病因。

concl-side.en: More affected hemisphere: {0}. Clinical signs are expected on the opposite side of the body.
concl-side.zh: 受累较重的大脑半球：{0}。临床体征预计位于对侧肢体。

caveat-msa-p.en: Putaminal hypometabolism is the supportive imaging feature of MSA in the MDS 2022 criteria. It also occurs in PSP and CBD, where the rest of the map differs.
caveat-msa-p.zh: 壳核代谢减低是 MDS 2022 标准中 MSA 的支持性影像特征。PSP 和 CBD 也可出现壳核减低，但其余脑区的表现不同。

caveat-msa-c.en: Cerebellar hypometabolism alone is not specific: other cerebellar degenerations show it too, and the MDS 2022 criteria accept only putaminal hypometabolism as supportive of MSA-C.
caveat-msa-c.zh: 单纯小脑代谢减低缺乏特异性，其他小脑变性疾病也可出现；MDS 2022 标准仅将壳核代谢减低列为 MSA-C 的支持性特征。

caveat-psp.en: The patterns of PSP and CBD overlap, and frontal hypometabolism also occurs in frontotemporal dementia. The MDS 2017 criteria list midbrain hypometabolism as a supportive imaging feature of PSP.
caveat-psp.zh: PSP 与 CBD 的代谢模式有重叠，额叶代谢减低亦见于额颞叶痴呆。MDS 2017 标准将中脑代谢减低列为 PSP 的支持性影像特征。

caveat-cbd.en: Corticobasal syndrome has several underlying pathologies (CBD, PSP, Alzheimer's disease). The map can suggest the syndrome but cannot establish the pathology; a more posterior, temporo-parietal decrease points to Alzheimer pathology.
caveat-cbd.zh: 皮质基底节综合征的病理基础多样（CBD、PSP、阿尔茨海默病）。代谢图可以提示该综合征，但不能确定病理；若减低偏后部（颞顶叶），提示阿尔茨海默病病理。

caveat-dlb.en: Posterior cortical hypometabolism also occurs in Parkinson's disease with cognitive impairment and in Alzheimer's disease. Occipital hypometabolism, with or without the cingulate island sign, is a supportive biomarker in the 2017 DLB criteria.
caveat-dlb.zh: 后部皮层代谢减低亦见于帕金森病伴认知障碍和阿尔茨海默病。枕叶代谢减低（伴或不伴扣带回岛征）是 2017 年 DLB 诊断标准中的支持性生物标志物。

caveat-pd.en: A relative increase depends on the intensity normalisation; it was counted only where every normalisation showed it. Levodopa can weaken the pattern.
caveat-pd.zh: 相对代谢增高受强度归一化方式影响，此处仅计入各归一化方式下均出现的增高。左旋多巴治疗可使该模式减弱。

find-hyper.en: Relative hypermetabolism (score 2 or higher, under every normalisation)
find-hyper.zh: 相对代谢增高（评分 ≥ 2，且各归一化方式下均出现）

find-brain.en: Share of the brain below −2: {0}%; above 2: {1}%. About 2% each is expected by chance.
find-brain.zh: 全脑评分低于 −2 的体素占 {0}%，高于 2 的占 {1}%；随机情况下各约 2%。

patterns-lead.en: Each bar shows how completely the regional scores show the features of a pattern, from 0 to 100. It is a similarity by fixed rules, not a probability. Features in dark type were found, those in gray were not.
patterns-lead.zh: 每条表示各脑区评分表现出该模式特征的完整程度（0–100）。它是按固定规则计算的相似度，不是概率。深色字的特征已出现，灰色字的特征未出现。

chip-spared.en: no decrease in striatum, brainstem or cerebellum
chip-spared.zh: 纹状体、脑干、小脑无减低

map-caption.en: Axial slices of the patient's normalised image at MNI z = {0} mm. Blue: lower uptake than the controls (score −2 or lower). Red to yellow: higher (2 or above). Radiological convention: the patient's left is on the right of each slice.
map-caption.zh: 患者归一化图像的轴位层面（MNI z = {0} mm）。蓝色：摄取低于对照（评分 ≤ −2）；红至黄色：高于对照（评分 ≥ 2）。按放射学惯例显示：图像右侧为患者左侧。

regions-note.en: A score is the mean of the map within the region; negative means lower uptake than the controls. Bold: abnormal (2 or more from zero). The columns after “L − R” give the score of the whole region under the other normalisations. * The finding changes with the normalisation.
regions-note.zh: 评分为该脑区内图像的平均值，负值表示摄取低于对照。粗体：异常（绝对值 ≥ 2）。“左 − 右”之后的各列为其他归一化方式下整个脑区的评分。* 该发现随归一化方式而变化。

region-medial-frontal.en: Medial frontal cortex and anterior cingulate

region-sensorimotor.zh: 中央周围区（感觉运动皮层）

note-few-controls.en: The reference holds {0} controls. At least 30 are recommended for the map of a single patient; with fewer, the scores are less stable.
note-few-controls.zh: 参考库仅含 {0} 例对照。单例分析建议至少 30 例；例数较少时评分不够稳定。

note-unadjusted.en: The scores are not adjusted for age and sex. If the patient is much older or younger than the controls, part of the difference is due to age.
note-unadjusted.zh: 评分未校正年龄和性别。若患者年龄与对照相差较大，部分差异可能来自年龄。

note-widespread.en: {0}% of the brain lies below −2. With such a widespread decrease the normalisation itself is uncertain and the patterns are hard to tell apart. Check the image quality and whether the patient was scanned like the controls.
note-widespread.zh: 全脑 {0}% 的体素评分低于 −2。减低如此广泛时，强度归一化本身不可靠，各模式难以区分。请核对图像质量，以及患者与对照的采集条件是否一致。

note-not-covered.en: Not scored, because less than half of the region lies inside the image: {0}.
note-not-covered.zh: 以下脑区位于图像内的部分不足一半，未予评分：{0}。

note-dependent.en: These findings change with the intensity normalisation and should be read with caution: {0}.
note-dependent.zh: 以下发现随强度归一化方式而变化，解读时应谨慎：{0}。

note-global-only.en: Increased only with global scaling (ps), which is probably an artefact of the normalisation: {0}.
note-global-only.zh: 以下脑区仅在全局均值缩放（ps）下表现为增高，很可能是归一化造成的伪影：{0}。

note-lowered.en: The confidence was lowered: findings that this pattern rests on change with the intensity normalisation. Without them the match is {0}/100.
note-lowered.zh: 置信度已下调：支持该模式的部分发现随强度归一化方式而变化；不计这些发现时，模式匹配度为 {0}/100。

limit-1.en: The analysis matches regional scores against patterns described in the literature, by fixed rules. The rules were not fitted to or validated on local patients, and the pattern match is not a probability of disease.
limit-1.zh: 本分析按固定规则将各脑区评分与文献报道的代谢模式进行匹配。这些规则未经本地患者数据拟合或验证，模式匹配度不代表患病概率。

limit-2.en: The diagnostic criteria (MSA 2022, PSP 2017, DLB 2017) count FDG-PET findings as supportive, not as required. Read the result together with the clinical course, MRI and dopamine-transporter imaging, and review the images themselves.
limit-2.zh: 诊断标准（MSA 2022、PSP 2017、DLB 2017）仅将 FDG-PET 所见列为支持性证据，而非必需条件。结果须结合临床病程、MRI 和多巴胺转运体显像综合判断，并应目视复核原始图像。

limit-3.en: The scores hold only if the patient was scanned and processed like the controls: same scanner and reconstruction, same spatial normalisation, eyes open or closed alike. Blood glucose, levodopa (on or off) and, on PET/MR, the attenuation correction also change the map.
limit-3.zh: 只有当患者与对照的采集和处理条件一致时评分才可靠：相同的扫描仪与重建方式、相同的空间标准化、相同的睁眼或闭眼状态。血糖、左旋多巴用药状态（开期或关期）以及 PET/MR 的衰减校正也会影响结果。

limit-4.en: Small structures (midbrain, pallidum, posterior putamen) are blurred at the resolution of PET and shrink with atrophy; part of a decrease there reflects loss of tissue.
limit-4.zh: 小结构（中脑、苍白球、壳核后部）受 PET 分辨率限制，且随萎缩而缩小；这些部位的减低部分反映组织丢失。

limit-5.en: Other causes of parkinsonism or dementia (Alzheimer's disease, frontotemporal dementia, vascular disease, normal-pressure hydrocephalus) are not modelled and can resemble one of these patterns.
limit-5.zh: 其他可引起帕金森综合征或痴呆的疾病（阿尔茨海默病、额颞叶痴呆、血管性病变、正常压力脑积水）未纳入模型，其表现可能与上述某一模式相似。
